Small free libraries copied here unchanged, so the panel works with no internet and needs no `npm install`.
Each keeps its own license file next to it, and each has a row in docs/Media_Licenses.csv.

- pickr/ : Pickr 1.9.1 by Simon Reinisch (MIT License), the Color Picker in every color box (Rule 2.48, Help 187).
  dist/pickr.min.js and dist/themes/classic.min.css from the npm package @simonwep/pickr (only the source map line was taken out of pickr.min.js).
